decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun no later than the expiration of five years beginning the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 3 - The bedsitting room and bathroom at first floor level shall be used only for a use ancillary to the use of the building as a doctor's surgery and shall not be used as a treatment room unless otherwise agreed in writing beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for a single doctor's surgery shall not be carried on between the hours of 2100 and 0700

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 6 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing no. 111-154-03 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.
description: Removal of condition 3 of 00676/77/P5 dated 8/02/1993 for the change of use from a residential dwelling house to a doctor's surgery
